title: Client-side OAuth initiate wiring (UserClickedGoogleSignIn → query string) has no test
detail: The #617 mechanism's only untested link: model.first_touch_params → initiate-URL query. Server boundary (auth_test.gleam) and to_query_string are pinned, but a wiring regression silently ships every OAuth signup unattributed — the exact bug this PR fixes. The client.update harness exists.
recommended_fix: Add client.update tests for UserClickedGoogleSignIn: params present → query string on /auth/oauth/google URI; empty params → query None. Closes the sole substantive gap.

title: OAuth callback error branches (cancel, missing code, missing PKCE, token-exchange failure) never exercised; added clear_cookie calls untested in situ
evidence:
server/src/auth/auth_handler.gleam:1038-1041:
      wisp.redirect("/login")
      |> wisp.set_cookie(req, cookie_names.pkce(), "", wisp.Signed, 0)
      |> first_touch_cookie.clear_cookie(req)
Eight call sites: lines 1040, 1072, 1081, 1090, 1141, 1247, 1258, 1268. Only coverage: first_touch_cookie_test.gleam:153-160 clear_cookie_expires_the_cookie_test (unit, on a fresh response) and the success path auth_integration_test.gleam:611-616 (Max-Age=0). No test drives any error branch.
detail: The diff added `|> first_touch_cookie.clear_cookie(req)` to every terminal OAuth response; only the success path and the function itself are pinned. Branches were pre-existing and untested; additions are one-liners of a unit-tested function — P3.
recommended_fix: Acceptable as-is. If hardening: one test driving handle_oauth_callback with an `error` query param, asserting both first-touch and PKCE cookies expire on the /login redirect.
